title.en: What to include in a bamboo skewer enquiry
title.zh: 竹签询盘需要哪些信息

excerpt.en: A simple checklist: product style, desired dimensions, order quantity, packaging and delivery destination.
excerpt.zh: 款式、期望尺寸、采购数量、包装形式和目的地，是沟通竹签采购的起点。

body.en:
## Start with your requirements
A simple checklist: product style, desired dimensions, order quantity, packaging and delivery destination.

Unsure about a dimension? Tell us how you plan to use the skewers. Ask for sample options and confirm specifications before placing an order. MOQ and timing depend on the confirmed product and packaging.

[Send an enquiry](/en/contact#rfq)
body.zh:
## 从需求开始
款式、期望尺寸、采购数量、包装形式和目的地，是沟通竹签采购的起点。

如果不确定尺寸，请说明竹签的使用场景。可在下单前咨询样品并确认规格。起订量和时间需根据最终产品与包装确认。

[提交询盘](/zh/contact#rfq)

如果不确定尺寸，请说明竹签的使用场景。可在下单前咨询样品并确认规格。起订量和时间需根据最终产品与包装确认。

excerpt.en: Build a packaging enquiry around your market and product range.
excerpt.zh: 围绕目标市场与产品系列，沟通包装需求。

body.en:
![Bamboo skewer packaging concept](/assets/current-template/packaging.webp)

## Start with your format
Tell us whether you need bulk packs, a retail sleeve or a private-label presentation. Include the desired quantity per pack, label language and any artwork requirements.

## Confirm before ordering
Minimum order quantity, packaging materials, sample arrangements and delivery timing are confirmed with your quotation. Product and packaging images are illustrative.

[Discuss your packaging](/en/contact#rfq)
body.zh:
![竹签包装示意](/assets/current-template/packaging.webp)

## 先确定包装形式
请说明需要散装、零售纸套还是品牌包装，并提供每包数量、标签语言和图稿需求。

## 下单前确认
起订量、包装材料、样品安排与交期均以报价确认为准。产品和包装图片仅作示意。

[咨询包装方案](/zh/contact#rfq)

excerpt.en: GrillBeats brings product selection and packaging enquiries together.
excerpt.zh: GrillBeats 为你集中展示竹签品类与包装选项。

body.en:
## A clear place to start
Explore bamboo skewers for small wholesale businesses, catering suppliers, restaurants and retail ranges. Choose a style, describe your requirements, and submit an enquiry.

## Details before decisions
We ask about dimensions, quantity, packaging and destination so your request is specific. Availability, minimum quantities and shipping terms are confirmed in the quotation.

[Explore the range](/en/products)
body.zh:
## 清晰的采购起点
为小型批发商、餐饮供应商、餐厅和零售系列选择竹签。先选款式，再说明规格和数量，即可提交询盘。

## 确认细节后再决定
请提供尺寸、数量、包装和目的地。供货情况、起订量和运输条款以报价确认为准。

[浏览产品](/zh/products)

excerpt.en: How information submitted through this website is used.
excerpt.zh: 我们如何使用通过网站提交的信息。

body.en:
We collect the contact details and purchasing requirements you submit to respond to your enquiry. Please do not include payment information or sensitive personal documents. Administrator login uses a session cookie. For a question about your submitted information, use the contact form and identify the enquiry concerned.

[Contact us](/en/contact)
body.zh:
我们收集你主动提交的联系方式和采购需求，用于处理询盘。请不要提交付款信息或敏感个人文件。管理员登录使用会话 Cookie。如需查询已提交的信息，请通过联系表单说明对应询盘。

[联系我们](/zh/contact)
